title: A screening whose consumer died
assertion: A run cut off while pricing (the consumer killed after a recorded batch, or a thread out of memory) is claimed again and emailed within about 3 minutes, its recorded batches kept and only its pending rows priced, at most three attempts: the job's 60-second heartbeat set on the existing queue and on every send, a run stale after 2 minutes without progress, and the sweep sending due runs again at their priority
noFileReason: A consumer is killed mid-run over a screening the tests submit in memory; no file.
